title: AX-200 repeated T17 trip
content: Technician found a dust-blocked intake filter and enclosure temperature of 51 C. Filter replacement and fan cleaning restored operation; load current returned below nameplate rating.

title: AX-200 hot motor and high current
content: High motor current persisted after airflow cleaning. Coupling was isolated and pump shaft binding was confirmed. Bearing service resolved the thermal trip.

title: Intermittent AX-200 start failure
content: A loose M12 feedback connector caused intermittent start faults. Pin inspection and connector replacement resolved the issue after supply voltage tested normal.

title: CV-40 overload after belt change
content: Conveyor overload began after maintenance. Belt tension exceeded specification and current was high. Correct tension and alignment restored normal current.
